faq_heading: Homes near Kwantlen Park Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Kwantlen Park Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Kwantlen Park Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Kwantlen Park Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Kwantlen Park Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are K B Woodward Elementary (0.4 km north-west), Old Yale Road Elementary (0.6 km south) and Theresa Clarke Elementary (0.9 km north).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Kwantlen Park Secondary in a straight line (21 elementary, 7 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is K B Woodward Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Guildford Park Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (1.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Honour Secondary School (1.0 km east), Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey) (1.6 km west), Queen Elizabeth Secondary (2.1 km south), L.A. Matheson Secondary (2.8 km south-west), North Surrey Learning Centre (2.8 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey), 1.6 km west of Kwantlen Park Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Kwantlen Park Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Kwantlen Park Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Kwantlen Park Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Honour Secondary School, the nearest other secondary school, 1.0 km east of Kwantlen Park Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
